description: TY2026: the complete senior story in one return — SS 86 inclusion + age-65 additional standard deductions + the OBBBA senior deduction. MFJ, both 65+, $40,000 pensions + $30,000 social security. Provisional 55,000: 50%-tier min(15,000, 11,500) capped at 6,000; 85%-tier 85% x 11,000 = 9,350 -> taxable SS $15,350. AGI 55,350; std 32,200 + 2 x 1,650 = 35,500; senior deduction 2 x 6,000 (MAGI under $150k). TI = 7,850 -> Table midpoint 7,875 -> $788. Net $788.00.
